name: clawd-hud-zq
description: clawd-hud-zq: two Claude Code mods, each installed on its own: a HUD side pane with session facts, subagents and animated mascots, and a strip above the prompt with thumbnails of the images pasted into it.

plugins.name: mod-hud
plugins.description: A side pane, toggled by /mod-hud: a HUD of the session (header, alerts, then session, context and prompt cache, limits, usage and todos in labelled sections) above every subagent in it (type, model, status, elapsed time, tool calls, current tool, result), with an opt-in status line.

plugins.name: mod-images
plugins.description: Thumbnails of the images pasted into the prompt, in a strip just above it before you send: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty, coloured half-block cells in other terminals, and /mod-images to see what it sees.
